given.note: The page asks again about Sam's attempt after it was signed in (a second poll under a new requestId, or a browser that lost sign-in-done.json's answer). The token left the server once, in that answer, and the server keeps only its sha256 (K-22 v1 sessions_token_hash_form), so it cannot be sent again: the code is used (K-22 v1 check_proof_code answers used) and a session names it (sessions_proof_code_key), so the answer is alreadySignedIn, with no token, and a page with no session starts a new sign-in (the security reviewer's gap 1 on 2413b65). A repeat under sign-in-done.json's own requestId answers the same.
